verdict.rationale: Motion's own docs clearly cover daily booking caps: once a daily meeting limit is hit, the calendar becomes unbookable. It also documents custom availability and ideal meeting windows, but these are recurring time-of-day or weekday preferences, not bounded date-range booking windows. missing for 10: buffers before and after meetings, minimum notice settings, date-range booking windows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, I can protect my calendar with buffers before and after meetings, minimum notice, daily booking caps, and date-range windows

citations.quote: Set daily limits and watch Motion enforce them automatically. When you hit your threshold, your calendar becomes unbookable
Put a cap on meeting overload. Set daily limits and watch Motion enforce them automatically.
